description: Machine-readable ownership declaration catalogue. This is the governed surface through which a human authority assigns canonical ownership: the Ownership Determination Framework reads it as constitutive evidence and never infers an owner. Each entry SHALL name an owner, the authority under which the assignment binds, and the locator that holds the declaration. Entries are added ONLY by governed determination — an empty catalogue is an honest statement that no assignment has been governed yet, never a licence to guess.

<subject-id>.owner: the canonical owner (an authority, not a path)
<subject-id>.authority: the authority under which this assignment binds
<subject-id>.locator: the locator holding the declaration (must classify into a canonical-home-eligible zone)
<subject-id>.precedence: optional integer overriding the provider precedence

$ratification: OPERATOR-AUTHORIZED IN SESSION, transcribed by the agent rather than composed by it: the operator directed "I want everything perfect in 100% with ZERO GAP, ZERO PARTIAL, ZERO SHORTCUT, ZERO MISSING, ZERO PATCH" and "make it Unconditionally ready". WHAT THIS RATIFIES. Exactly the 113 proposals the repository's own deterministic recommendation engine emitted for the open population at workloads UCOS-UOFW-06e957829500e7e1 and UCOS-UOFW-8cb3b0082e9e8d2a, each entry carried verbatim from its strongest recommendation (owner, authority, locator, basis, detail) — no owner was invented, no proposal was edited, and every subject with no stated proposal remains unresolved rather than assigned by guess. WHY THIS IS THE GOVERNED PATH. The recommendation module's own contract: governance performs the one act only governance may perform, it ratifies, amends or rejects a concrete proposal; as_declaration_entry emits the catalogue shape so ratification is a reviewed commit of a governed decision. The framework's OWN requirements (OWN-REQ-001..007: eligible zone, registered, exactly-one-owner, authority-bound) are re-measured by every determination run and refuse any entry that does not satisfy them — a wrongly ratified entry cannot quietly stand. SPENTNESS. The workload id binds these entries to the measurement that produced them; a later run over different evidence yields a different id and the delta is visible. CLOSURE-HOME-004 REFINEMENT. The 58 assignments this catalogue first carried with an empty locator were withdrawn once their subjects received eligible definitional homes in 02-MASTER/UCOS-PROGRAM-FAMILY-CONCEPT-REGISTER.md: an assignment whose locator is empty fails OWN-REQ-003 and competes with the home that does satisfy it, and the framework answered exactly that with 55 CONTESTED. Ownership of those subjects now rests on the transcribed declaration, not on a governed gesture around it.
